reviews.comment: 1 blocker (B1): update_module can override a built-in status-transition/handover module (locked by KIND, not id), writing a file the loader then rejects — bricks the composer, unrecoverable over MCP. Fix: kind-aware lock in writeDefinition. Everything else passes; build/lint/typecheck/306 tests green.
Docs don't state the composer MCP's primary purpose — that it's for helping users handle insight-flow (IS) things. Lead the docs/README with the why before setup + tools.

fix.comment: Fixed both blockers: B1 (kind-aware locked guard in writeDefinition via shared isModuleEditLocked; built-in transition/handover override now refused, custom allowed) + N1 display flag; human docs blocker (composer-mcp index + both READMEs now lead with the primary purpose). tsc/lint/build/website-build + 306 tests green.
